provenance.scope: Illustrative configuration only; replace with requirements and settings appropriate to your task.

trocar_layout.text: Assess the projected layout using the configured angle band and qualitative symmetry requirement.
trocar_layout.interpretation: Trocar endpoints define the triangle; the navel is a reference landmark. Distinguish missing measurements from deviations.
trocar_layout.limits: Projected geometry does not establish three-dimensional placement.

circular_disinfection.text: Assess circular wiping around the target region.
circular_disinfection.interpretation: Use the target-relative trajectory; do not infer sterilization effectiveness from the visible path.

hand_press.text: Assess whether the visible hand posture is consistent with pressing.
hand_press.interpretation: Use finger configuration, placement and temporal support. Configure the ROI for the supplied video.
hand_press.limits: Hand pose does not measure physical pressure.
